content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Design assets

The architecture behind selling design assets with crypto payments revolves around ownership and accessibility. Creators can leverage tools like Cloudflare Workers and NOWPayments to create a fully operational store without traditional platform fees. Unlike Gumroad, which takes up to 10% of each sale, this system retains more of your earnings, empowering creators to reinvest into their work. This approach not only circumvents financial barriers but also ensures that creators maintain full control over their products and sales.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At its core, the architecture consists of free tools and services that work seamlessly together. Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages serve as the hosting platform, while Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers handle backend logic. This setup allows for automated product delivery and order management. NOWPayments integrates easily for crypto transactions, converting currency at the moment of sale, ensuring that you receive your earnings without the high costs associated with traditional platforms. This combination provides a stable and reliable foundation for digital commerce.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is specifically designed for digital creators in regions where conventional payment platforms are unavailable or costly. Whether you're selling ebooks, courses, templates, or music beats, this architecture provides the necessary tools to operate independently. Creators in countries like Ghana, Kenya, or Venezuela benefit greatly from this infrastructure as it opens doors to a global market where they can sell their digital products without limitations or excessive fees. This model supports creators in taking full ownership of their business.
No more 10% fees — keep more of your earnings.
The Components That Make It Work Together

Key components of this architecture include hosting services like Cloudflare Pages, backend logic provided by Cloudflare Workers, and order management through services like Supabase or Google Sheets. Integration with NOWPayments ensures secure crypto transactions with a low fee structure. Each part is designed to work harmoniously, allowing creators to focus on their products rather than the complexities of managing a digital storefront. Together, these elements create a robust ecosystem that supports seamless transactions and product delivery.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To implement this architecture, start by setting up your hosting on Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. Next, configure your backend using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to manage orders. Then, integrate NOWPayments for payment processing and configure your products for automated delivery. Finally, test the entire stack to ensure everything works smoothly. By following these steps, you can launch your sovereign digital store and begin selling design assets immediately.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The fastest path to your first sovereign digital product sale is a three-step process. First, create a NOWPayments account — configure your wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as starting points, generate your API key, and set the webhook endpoint URL. Second, choose your stack: Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages plus Google Apps Script and takes most creators four to six hours following the Sovereign Blueprint at $47; Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase and is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Third, upload your product files, set your prices in USD, and run a complete mainnet test transaction before promoting.
Transform your digital sales with full ownership and control.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

For those looking to sell digital assets like ebooks or templates without relying on mainstream platforms, consider exploring the Complete Builder Kit ($197). This kit includes essential blueprints and templates to help you quickly establish your own store at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online by setting up a digital storefront using free hosting services and integrating NOWPayments for crypto transactions. This method bypasses traditional payment platforms, allowing you to retain full earnings.

Utilizing a sovereign commerce stack with components like Cloudflare Pages and NOWPayments allows you to sell digital downloads without incurring high platform fees. This architecture gives you full ownership of your sales.
Can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip?

Yes, by using a combination of free hosting, backend services, and crypto payment processors like NOWPayments, you can sell templates and fonts independently, avoiding the fees associated with platforms like Gumroad or Payhip.
What are the advantages of using crypto payments?

Crypto payments offer lower transaction fees and faster processing times compared to traditional payment methods. Additionally, they provide a level of anonymity and security that can be beneficial for both sellers and buyers.
How can I ensure my digital products are delivered automatically?

By integrating your digital store with Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers, you can automate the delivery of your products upon payment confirmation, ensuring customers receive their purchases instantly.
Bypass platform restrictions with sovereign commerce infrastructure.
